{{Quote|Another fine mess you got us into, Dannl.|Achk Med-Beq to Dannl Faytonni|<ref name="Departure">''[[The Clone Wars: Departure]]''</ref>}}
'''Achk Med-Beq''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] present in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were searching for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. He along with his partner [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]] were posing as [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]] officers attempting to [[Con artist/Legends|con]] patrons out of their [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref>

Med-Beq and Faytonni later conned the aspiring criminal [[Magaloof/Legends|Magaloof]].<ref name="DBM">{{DB|character|magaloof|Magaloof}}</ref> He once rescued [[Llollulion]] from the [[CoCo District Constabulary]] on Coruscant.<ref name="Hnn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|news/13516_2.html|Coco District Jailbreak Alert}}</ref>

Later Med-Beq and Faytonni fled from [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]] under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Faro Argyus/Legends|Faro Argyus]]. They claimed [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] ship from [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. Unfortunately, the ship was programmed to bring them back to the Senate.<ref name="Departure" />

==Biography==
Achk Med-Beq was the criminal partner of [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]]. Med-Beq was probably the more ambitious and inventive of the two. Faytonni almost ended the partnership after an unsuccessful case concerning a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mine. Med-Beq and Faytonni fled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

Eventually, the duo was imprisoned, but in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] they escaped from the [[CoCo Penitentiary]] via a laundry speeder, accompanied by another escapee, [[Llollulion]]. A detection message was sent, but the two crooks were once again active in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo District]]. Faytonni had a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] party where the two could get uniforms of the Republic [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]]. The two remained hidden for a time in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] where female customers were lured away. When [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] was caught in the club, Med-Beq was mingling with the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] [[Lunae Minx/Legends|Lunae Minx]] and [[Ayy Vida/Legends|Ayy Vida]]. Med-Beq and Faytonni also became interested in the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] artist [[Oakie Dokes/Legends|Oakie Dokes]] and asked Dokes to sponsor them in future projects. Faytonni was, as usual, very charming, but Dokes sensed danger. An advantage for both parties meant for a Swokes Swokes. Indeed, as much as "wretches." How this deal ended was not known.

Med-Beq also collaborated with the naive thief [[Magaloof/Legends|Magaloof]]. Together they snapped some business just Med-Beq lured Magaloof into a trap by convincing him to rob a jewelry store in CoCo Town. [[Magaloof]] the shop robbed empty but was restrained by Dannl Faytonni, who, disguised as Republic Officer, gave a sermon to the [[Leffingite/Legends|Leffingite]]. Magaloof hurried Med-Beq to inform him about the failed burglary, but Med-Beq had disappeared.

With the spoils in their possession, Faytonni and Med-Beq went forward. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] the two were still fleeing the [[Senate Commando]]s and still wore uniforms of the [[Judicial Forces]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Dannl Faytonni and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Med-Beq stole the [[J-type star skiff]] of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in order to escape but failed because the ship was programmed to go to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] upon takeoff.

==Personality and traits==
Med-Beq was most likely the more inventive and ambitious of the con artist pair of him and Faytonni.<ref name="DB" /> He stood at 1.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and weighed 78 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="H2H" /> Med-Beq possessed [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and dark skin. A [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] surrounded his right eye.<ref name="DB" />

==Skills and abilities==
The con artist pair was able to get away from Corellia due to Med-Beq's inventiveness.<ref name="FF44">{{FactFile|44|COR 21-22|Coruscant – Outlander Club}}</ref> In combat, Med-Beq used a double jab and had less fighting experience than Faytonni.<ref name="H2H" />

==Equipment==
Med-Beq used a blaster pistol.<ref name="H2H" />

==Behind the scenes==
Achk Med-Beq was portrayed by and named after [[Ahmed Best]], the actor who played [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].

This method of basing a fictional entity name on a real-life person name is known as a [[tuckerization]].

He was rendered into an Action Figure during 2003.
